kjv: Except a man be born again
mine: unless one is born from above
note: anothen means both "again" and "from above"; Nicodemus hears "again" (3:4), but John's usage (3:31, 19:11) is "from above". English cannot keep the pun; the KJV picks Nicodemus' sense.

kjv: the Son of man which is in heaven
note: TR adds "ho on en to ourano"; absent from P66, P75, Sinaiticus, B.

kjv: should not perish, but have eternal life
mine: may have eternal life in him

kjv: he that believeth not the Son shall not see life
mine: whoever does not obey the Son shall not see life
note: apeitheo is "disobey", not "disbelieve"; John contrasts believing with disobedience.
